email.body1:
Alfred, saw Forward Thinking Systems keep expanding FleetCam with on-device AI detection and OBD-II data.

A growing product line usually surfaces more in-market fleets than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for FleetCam off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Alfred, quick follow-up for FleetCam.

An expanding product line usually lifts the number faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new target, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings FleetCam needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Alfred, last bit of proof for FleetCam.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how FleetCam's reply rate likely compares to other fleet and telematics companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
